drafted_from: tools/reply-by-keyword-rule/tool-rows.json (tool:send-a-reply-on-youtube), do-work/send-a-reply.mjs, read-data/reply-places.json, test/decide-and-send.test.mjs; the example was run on the test fixture with a stand-in network
start_here: Say to your AI: "Send the YouTube reply that tool:decide-the-replies chose for the comment that asked the price from my YouTube account." It runs tool:send-a-reply-on-youtube with account_id and that one decision and tells you whether it was sent.
no_lists_because: It names no list of yours: it takes one decision and keeps only its own reply-kept record for that decision, so a reply is sent once.
instructions: 1. Connect your YouTube account first; its connection is named service_connection:youtube or service_connection:youtube:<name>.
2. Run tool:decide-the-replies for the place and keep only a decision whose action is send; this tool refuses any other.
3. Say "Send that reply": the AI runs tool:send-a-reply-on-youtube at @workshop-tools with {account_id, decision}. It posts publicly on your account, so run it only for replies your rules chose.

4. Read status: sent (with key and message_id), already-sent (that key has a record and nothing is sent again), refused (with reason: window-closed, host-not-allowed or unknown-kind), failed (with what the place said) or not-known (no answer came back; look on the place yourself, it is never retried).

worked_examples.title: Send the price reply to a YouTube comment, once
worked_examples.ask: Send the reply my rules chose for the price comment.
worked_examples.given: From tools/reply-by-keyword-rule/test/decide-and-send.test.mjs (the shipped YouTube row test, run here with a stand-in network that answers {"id":"Ugx1.reply"}): the decision is the one tool:decide-the-replies chose for the comment Ugx1 ("what is the price", someone else's). YouTube sets no window. The request goes to https://www.googleapis.com/youtube/v3/comments?part=snippet with {"snippet":{"parentId":"Ugx1","textOriginal":"The list is linked below."}}.
worked_examples.hands_back: {"status":"sent","key":"Ugx1:rule:prices","message_id":"Ugx1.reply"}; running it again answers {"status":"already-sent","key":"Ugx1:rule:prices"} without a request.
